title: hoa.2d.projector~
description: `hoa.2d.projector~` decomposes a 2D ambisonic sound field from the circular-harmonics domain into a set of plane-wave output channels. Its order and number of plane waves are set at initialization, for example `hoa.2d.projector~ 3 7` uses order 3 and produces seven plane-wave channels (with `@n` limited to 1–63).
